# FeralEcho — dependency manifest
#
# Generated by scanning every real (non-archived, non-scaffold, non-backup)
# .py file under this repo for top-level imports via `ast`, then cross-
# referencing each third-party name against `pip freeze` in the actual
# live `feral_echo` conda environment this project runs in. Versions below
# are exact pins of what is confirmed currently installed and working here
# — not guessed, not taken from any package's own latest release.
#
# Excluded from the scan as not real project source: sandbox/scripts/archive/,
# app/core/self_edit_backups/, app/core/self_edit_plans/, staging/,
# archive_janitor/, archive_optional_files/, continuity_backups/,
# memory/snapshots/, trash_autonomous/, and scaffold-sprawl directories
# (chatbot/, new_directory/, etc. — see CLAUDE.md's Finding 30/7 on these).
#
# Python: 3.12.13 (this repo has not been verified against any other version)
# Environment manager: conda (`conda activate feral_echo`) — this file
# covers pip-installable packages only; conda-only packages, if any exist
# outside this list, are not captured here.
#
# NOT included below, deliberately:
#   - cffi — imported only as an optional, try/except-guarded dependency in
#     sandbox/safe_exec_wrapper.py (patches cffi.FFI if present). Not
#     actually installed in the live environment this file was generated
#     against, and the code already handles its absence. Install manually
#     (`pip install cffi`) only if you specifically need that guard active.
#   - location, motion, clipboard — imported only by thunderhead.py, which
#     is a reference copy of a script meant to run on iOS (Pythonista/Pyto),
#     not in this conda environment. Not real dependencies of the server.
